$comment: Hand-written help for what scripts/kbasic-help-data.cjs cannot derive from the spec: block statements' syntax (the spec's EBNF spans lines) and the keywords that are only parts of other statements. Keep it small; the generator reports what needs an entry.

AS.summary: Gives the type of a variable, array, constant, parameter or FUNCTION result.

AT.summary: PRINT AT row, column positions the cursor; DIM ... AT address maps a variable to memory.
display: DIM name AS type AT address

BIN.summary: Reads the token after it as binary digits: BIN 101 is 5.

BYREF.summary: The parameter receives the caller's variable, not a copy of its value.

BYVAL.summary: The parameter receives a copy of the value (the default unless default_byref is on).

CODEBANK.summary: Places the routines and data in the block in a memory bank (a Klive BASIC extension); bank 0 is resident.

ELSE.summary: Starts the branch an IF runs when no condition holds.
display: IF expr THEN … ELSE … END IF

ELSEIF.summary: Starts another tested branch of a block IF.

ENDIF.summary: Closes an IF block; the same as END IF.

FARPTR.summary: A banked address as a ULong: the bank in bits 16-23, the address in bits 0-15.

FASTCALL.summary: Calling convention: the first argument comes in registers (A, HL or DE:HL) and the routine has no stack frame.

display: FOR name = expr TO expr [STEP expr] … NEXT [name]
FUNCTION [FASTCALL | STDCALL] name[(params)] [AS type] … END FUNCTION

LOOP.summary: Closes a DO loop, optionally testing a condition at the bottom.

NEXT.summary: Closes a FOR loop; it may name the loop variable, which must then match.

REM.summary: A comment to the end of the line; ' is the short form.

STDCALL.summary: Calling convention (the default): arguments on the stack and a stack frame for locals.

STEP.summary: The amount a FOR loop's variable changes by on each NEXT (1 when omitted).
display: FOR name = expr TO expr STEP expr

TAB.summary: In PRINT, moves to a column (taken modulo 32).

THEN.summary: Ends an IF or ELSEIF condition; it is optional.

TO.summary: Separates the limits of a FOR loop, an array bound or a string slice.

UNTIL.summary: A DO loop's exit test: the loop ends when the condition holds.

WEND.summary: Closes a WHILE loop; the same as END WHILE.
